title: Can latent rollout consistency identify faithful latent dynamics?
setting: A 2D state is rotated by one of four discrete action angles and observed through a 6-D linear-plus-tanh mixing with Gaussian noise. A whitened PCA encoder is learned from 160 transitions per trial, and two latent dynamics models are fit on the same latents: an equivariant orthogonal (Procrustes) map per action (faithful) and an unconstrained least-squares map per action fit on one-step pairs (unfaithful). Each run repeats 80 independent trials; in each trial a model-selection criterion picks the better of the two on held-out data, and the metric is the fraction of trials in which it picks the faithful model.

paper.title: Understanding the limits of latent world models
paper.claim: Latent rollout consistency (LRC) at longer horizons exposes unfaithful latent dynamics that one-step latent prediction error does not reveal.

metric.name: rank_acc
metric.description: Fraction of trials (ties count 0.5) in which the chosen criterion ranks the faithful equivariant model above the unfaithful least-squares model, using held-out rollouts. Chance is 0.5.

factors.name: method
factors.description: Criterion used to rank the two latent models: held-out one-step normalised latent prediction error (baseline) or normalised latent rollout error (1 - R^2) at the configured horizon against latents encoded from realized observations (LRC).

factors.name: horizon
factors.description: Rollout horizon H used by LRC. At H=1 LRC coincides with the one-step criterion; the one-step baseline ignores H.

factors.name: obs_noise
factors.description: Std of Gaussian observation noise added before encoding, in both training and evaluation. It makes the encoded latents noisy, so least-squares regression shrinks the learned dynamics.

factors.name: nonlinearity
factors.description: Strength of the tanh nonlinearity in the observation map. When nonzero, the linear whitened encoder cannot exactly invert the mixing, so the latent is a distorted view of the state and exact equivariance is harder to satisfy.
